protocol: Same frozen images per model; original training samples retained; old and expanded validation/test deduplicated without reference to model predictions
perceptual_hash: 64-bit DCT pHash; exclude cross-split Hamming distance <=2; not a guarantee of scene independence
label_correction: Copied labels are clipped against the connected yellow robot hood; original image/label files remain unchanged
limitations: Same supplied identities and simulated environment
Automatic geometric labels are not exhaustively manually audited
Validation is for checkpoint selection; test is for final comparison; never train on these images
